 Thunder’s Isaiah Hartenstein, Nikola Topic connect for textbook alley-oop dunk vs. Clippers
 Oklahoma City Thunder center Isaiah Hartenstein and guard Nikola Topic executed a perfect two-man game against the Los Angeles Clippers.
 By Paolo Mariano • Updated Nov 13, 2026 at 11:36 PM ET • 2 min read Add ClutchPoints on Google Thomas Shea-Imagn Images The Oklahoma City Thunder visited the Los Angeles Clippers at Intuit Dome in the NBA Cup on Friday, hoping to end a two-game skid suffered at the hands of the Portland Trail Blazers .
 The Thunder have been hobbled by major injuries to Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren, and Cason Wallace, and everyone needs to step up to get back on track.
 Nikola Topic made his season debut against the Clippers. He immediately made a good play in the first quarter, driving to the lane and attracting the defense before making the perfect lob to Isaiah Hartenstein for the easy dunk .
 Expand Tweet 
 Topic has always been a gifted passer, but he has struggled to get his career going. Drafted by Oklahoma City with the No. 12 pick in 2024, he missed his rookie year due to an ACL injury. Last year, he was diagnosed with testicular cancer, limiting him to just 10 games.
 Hartenstein, for his part, has been consistently solid , filling the void left by Holmgren in the frontcourt. Entering the game against the Clippers, he was averaging 8.0 points, 10.1 rebounds, 3.7 assists, and 1.2 steals.
 Article Continues Below The 21-year-old Topic could see more action with Ajay Mitchell still sidelined by an ankle sprain.
 While the Thunder have played well despite their depleted roster, a collective effort is needed to sustain their strong showing. Coach Mark Daigneault has preached about having a next-man-up mentality to help Shai Gilgeous-Alexander amid their challenging stretch.
 As of this writing, the Thunder are trailing the Clippers in the second quarter. Hartenstein has six points, three rebounds, and two assists, while Topic has three rebounds, two assists, and one steal.
